You can't pick up a success mindset from people who don't have one.

Kevin explains that the most successful people he talks about all built a mastermind: close relationships with people who have more money, more intelligence, more health and more connections.

He says without a group like that, you never take on that mentality. Arnold Schwarzenegger trained with champions and learned how they thought, not just how they trained.

Who in your life makes you think bigger?
